title: Two-Stone Hand Quern
description: One newly authored static grain-hand-mill appearance: a broad low lower stone, a distinct thick annular upper stone with a raised funnel-like central feed eye, and one offset upright wooden grip. Three closed editable meshes and three opaque constant matte PBR roles. This is a pair of broad stone bodies, not the old mortar with a loose pestle or a tall coffee-grinder barrel/crank assembly. All dimensions and faceted profiles are new game-art construction, not a replica of a named museum specimen. Metres, Z up, true whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Hidden small fixed overlaps connect the display; no movable interface, spindle, grinding grooves, actual milling, grain flow, food performance, historical attribution, manufacture or safety claim.
